author: core_review
scope: V1-03B Core read-only persistent lifecycle demand. Root owns Pro consumer evidence, final integrated suites, release classification and commit/push.

contract: Frozen snapshot and nested DemandCounts; available and complete are distinct.
When available, counts.queued remains a confirmed lower bound even if other tasks are unknown.
queue_count and waiting_count are None unless the snapshot is available and complete; unknown is never interpreted as known zero.
waiting_count is queued plus evaluation_pending. Claimed and executing tasks are not counted as waiting.
First evaluation and explicit evaluation retry share the recorded training COMPLETE / evaluation PENDING classification; no limited retry-candidate query is used.
Read-only existing-database opener, schema validation and one BEGIN read transaction; bounded 256-row buffers contain normalized state enums, not task configurations, titles or metric payloads.
Explicit BINARY global-state and stage comparisons; the stored mirror must be TEXT before lower() normalization.
Missing historical stage rows can preserve queued/completed compatibility. Recorded NULL, insufficient running-stage information, or terminal tasks with an IN_PROGRESS stage remain unknown.
No database creation, migration, reconciliation, admission, queue mutation, result-artifact read, provider call or GPU probe.

freeze.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 -m pytest --collect-only -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_persistent_research_demand.py

first_implemented_run.command: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 PYTHONPATH=src CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= python3 -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests/test_persistent_research_demand.py --tb=short

coverage: Known empty catalog and deep snapshot immutability.
Real mode=ro/query_only read, one transaction, closed connection, unchanged bytes and no configuration/title/metric SELECT.
2507 queued tasks and 257 pending evaluations, exceeding existing dispatcher/retry query limits.
Actual first-evaluation and dedicated evaluation-retry lifecycle transitions.
Future evaluation PENDING during active training is not yet waiting evaluation work.
Known queue lower bound survives unrelated mirror/global conflicts; exact counts become unknown.
Present NULL stage values differ from genuinely missing historical rows/tables.
Missing, invalid, incompatible, symlinked and hardlinked databases are not created or repaired.
Duplicate identity/join rows, malformed schema and interrupted reads discard all partial results.
mechanism_acceptance.note: The file was frozen before implementation and was only collected at that stage. Missing old API behavior was not run or counted as a historical regression. The original 22 tests were not edited after freeze.

draft_boundary_regressions.snapshot_scope: Complete original 171-line research_demand.py module, byte-identical SHA to the initially implemented draft.

import importlib

snapshot = Path('docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-03b-before-demand-state-types.py')
module = importlib.import_module('orze.core.research_demand')

raise SystemExit(pytest.main(['-q', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider', 'tests/test_research_demand_state_boundaries.py', '--tb=short']))

fixes: Check typeof(i.status) before lower() can coerce a stored BLOB into an accepted text mirror.
Classify FAILED/SKIPPED/ARCHIVED with a recorded IN_PROGRESS stage as unknown; retain real inactive tasks including historical skipped PENDING stages.
draft_boundary_regressions.note: All six frozen assertions passed after the two narrow fixes. This did not redefine admission, scientific validity, arbitrary stage-name semantics, or the lifecycle writer.

limitations: This is a point-in-time recorded lifecycle backlog, not proof of ready work, current process ownership, scientific evidence, artifact validity or CPU/GPU capacity.
No claim of cross-host exactly-once dispatch, shared quota enforcement, attempt adoption or task generation admission is made.
The read snapshot is not atomic with result files; this module deliberately does not read those files.
Only the component/targeted suites above are recorded here. Final Core/Pro/paired full-suite results were not yet available for this document and are owned by root in the integrated evidence ledger.
